sentences.en: On the whole, the elite are not sensitive to criticism.
sentences.zh: 总体来说，精英们不太敏感于批评。

sentences.en: Elite soldiers are trained even harder than most special forces.
sentences.zh: 精锐士兵接受的训练比大多数特种部队还要艰苦。

sentences.en: Elite soldiers are almost always selected among the special forces.
sentences.zh: 精锐士兵几乎总是从特种部队中选拔出来的。

mnemonic: e（出）+lite=lig（选）→选出的（人物）→精英人物
